title: A mix says how loud it is, and stops itself running past what a file can hold
goal: Three sounds playing together at the level they were recorded at add up to more than a sound file can carry, and the app says nothing about it: no meter while it plays, no mark on the export, and the written file comes out distorted. Show how loud the mix is and stop it clipping.
acceptance: While a document plays, something on screen says how loud the mix is coming out, and it reads high when it is high
A mix loud enough to distort is marked before it is written, not discovered afterwards
Writing the mix out never produces a file louder than it can carry
Three sounds at the level they were recorded at, played together, come out as three sounds rather than as noise
